description: Specify mixed models using familiar ASReml or brms-style formula syntax and estimate admitted structures via INLA or brms (Stan). The supported surface includes multi-stratum designs, per-environment residual variances, baseline genotype-by-environment terms, known-precision genomic and pedigree models, separable AR1 spatial fields and univariate P-splines; selected richer covariance models use brms. Factor-analytic genotype-by-environment covariance is deliberately refused in this release. Results are returned through the standard R modelling ecosystem, while unsupported structures raise typed refusals naming the nearest implemented alternative.
name: flexyBayes: Flexible Bayesian Mixed Models with ASReml and brms-Style Syntax
